Elegir tu primera baraja de tarot es una: Choosing your first tarot deck is a more personal decision than it seems. Prioriza un mazo con significados o pala: Prioritize a deck with meanings or keywords printed on each card: it speeds up learning while you build your own intuition. Además del clásico Rider-Waite-Smith, ex: Besides the classic Rider-Waite-Smith, there are other major schools of tarot with their own visual rules. Themed decks (nature, mythology, cats, dark or pastel) keep the classic 78-card structure but reinterpret the images with total artistic freedom — they make an excellent second deck once you know the traditional meanings well, because they force you to recognize each card's archetype beyond its specific illustration.
